Sample.evidence_source: Of the 13 participants that were recruited, four participants disclosed that they had previously attempted suicide. The interviews of these four young men are the focus of this article.

Country.evidence_source: The interviews with these young men were analysed to explore the experiences of a specific group of people (South African male university students who had attempted suicide).

Population.evidence_source: The interviews of these four young men are the focus of this article. ... (South African male university students who had attempted suicide).

Type.evidence_source: The study used qualitative data, which was collected as part of the research component of a Master's degree in Psychology (Meissner 2013). ... The analysis of the larger data set has been published elsewhere (Meissner, Bantjes, and Kagee 2016).
